title: China expands rare earth export licensing requirements
summary: Beijing widened the scope of dual-use rare earth materials requiring export licenses, citing national security.
notes: Worth tracking against the 2023 gallium and germanium controls. The pattern suggests escalation is incremental and tied to US semiconductor restriction cycles rather than a single triggering event.

title: US tightens outbound investment screening for advanced chips
summary: Treasury finalized rules restricting US investment into Chinese advanced semiconductor and AI firms.
notes: This closes one of the remaining channels for capital flow into Chinese chip design houses. Relevant to CHIPS Act follow-on analysis.

title: EU CBAM transitional reporting moves toward full implementation
summary: The EU confirmed the timeline for CBAM certificate purchase obligations to begin, affecting steel, cement, and aluminum importers.
notes: Direct relevance to the ESG and trade law track. Compare against Korea's own carbon border mechanism discussions.
